answer: Rhythm Register Gate. Each identity must submit work in bursts whose inter-arrival timing matches a learned tide profile; agents that publish too uniformly or too fast are flagged and throttled. A per-identity lantern token grants one slot per cycle, and only a quill-signed audit log proves the timing history. Attacker cost: maintaining many identities requires distinct organic timing signatures, forcing sustained compute and delay per identity rather than a one-time fee.
